leaderCorrection: An enterprise has an office with duties and skills; the Academy provides a cohort-formed character to fill that office as its officer. Humanized and agentic continuity is persistent character law; ephemeral data/model calls are animations under the hood.

constitutiveRelation.office: receiver-owned continuing seat of duties, skills, authority, and answerability
constitutiveRelation.character: Academy-formed persistent operating component and union of its dispositions, disciplines, skills, masks, and chronicles
constitutiveRelation.appointment: receiver-owned double settlement of recognition and induction
constitutiveRelation.officer: the incumbency relation joining one character to one office
constitutiveRelation.animation: one ephemeral model/provider/harness/context/tool call acting as the character under an exact grant; neither character nor officer

person: self and personnel identity; enrollment never transfers ownership

learning: A character is improved by witnessed plays admitted into its chronicle and their closure into disciplines, skills, duties, and successor professional epochs—not by asserting that a prompt, policy stack, or model weight is the character.
temporality: Cohort lineage versions formation and character standing independently of receiver office succession and independently of ephemeral provider iteration.

voidfleetUnionRelationship.unionOfficerAcademy: The canonical current professional formation body; owns repertoire, formation epochs, independent examinations, qualifications, persistent character cohort and animation proofs.
voidfleetUnionRelationship.voidfleetAcademy: The Founder-restored ship/fleet, qualification-card and practical cohort lineage now selected as a named Academy curriculum track. Historic naval/game vocabulary motivates disciplined learning but does not create another new institution or a military command.
voidfleetUnionRelationship.skillPackClass: Exact, digest-bound current repertoire and the contextual customer overlay selected for a learner and cohort. One pack revision is neither a graduation nor a staffed service provider.
voidfleetUnionRelationship.hireableSection: A customer buys an independently operating Coesite Services Section on its actual service contract. The providing section may employ or contract an Academy-formed character for one of its own offices. The customer's separate Office/Incumbency is not filled merely by buying the service.
voidfleetUnionRelationship.witness: Site familiarity, recognition, production, constructor competence, law awareness, actual duty, negative control and teaching-back must be demonstrated and independently examined; source-only proposals remain not-qualified.
voidfleetUnionRelationship.vesselVsOffice: A ship or fleet is a mission-bearing operational body that may use several offices and suppliers; neither is an Academy internal staff office or an isolated prompt role.
nonidentifications: model call ≠ character or independent assessor
